full_page.content:
Page 11 Cont.
Dec. 18 Mr. Schuvin - about 50 - married non-c. yrs ago - still a good char- itable man but otherwise has dropped practice of religion.
Luella Walraven - 17 - of Essex Michigan - broke ankle - off bycicle two yrs ago .... poorly
Page 12
Dec. 22 Walter Jazinski - 50 - Heart Enlargement ....
Mrs. Rose Fortucsi - 47 - has near relative (only living Br.) who seems to have little or no conscience in regard to common property. Donald Plouff - 6 - rumatic fever and heart - half dozen Drs. no hope.
Young Mrs. DeCorte - 27 - baby & relatives. ...
1942, January
January 1942
Mrs. Anna Boichak - 50 - only son soldier - 26 accidently killed in California - finds it hard to be resigned.
Jules Popelier - 68 - stomach-cancer
Jan. 5th Mrs. Everyl McRae - 31 - Threatened with operation - feared next week.
N. B. Young man with hopeless cancer of tongue reported cured - His Mother having come to these Wed. blessings for four years - father non Cath.
Mrs. M. premo of Saginaw - 41 - threatened with fibroid tuomer ....
Page 13 Jan. 5 Paul Kirchoff - 49 - here To-day on stretcher - seeming hopeless cancer inward - is told of ulcers -
6 Patricia Sampe - 3 - badly burned.
Wm. Loney - non c - Elderly - Stroke - blood clot feared ....
7 Mrs. Rose Jordan - 53 - fears cancer - married German Lutheran (1) has two sons raised Catholic as best she could, but the elder one (2) wayward .... ungrateful.
